notes:
Overview: regional emergency services authority (dispatch + situational awareness) evaluating Redwood Private for an air-gapped inference platform. Priority: on-prem model serving inside secure operations center (SOC), strict no-internet egress, HSM-backed key management.

Key quotes / paraphrases: “We cannot accept any cloud egress for operational data”; “Must demonstrate FIPS-compliant key management and audit trail”.

Workload summary: chat for incident triage (dispatcher assistant), embeddings for incident/document search across 10+ years of logs, reranking for evidence retrieval, summarization for after-action reports. Expected steady-state: ~150 concurrent chat sessions during peak, 200 requests/minute ingestion batch for nightly indexing. Latency targets: median response <150ms for assistant queries; acceptable tail up to 400ms for larger summarize jobs.

Model preferences: open/quantized models (7B-13B) optimized for latency/cost. Need smaller fallback model family for offline degraded operations. Strong interest in Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization profiles, batching).

Security / compliance notes: Fed/state audit requirements, mandatory SSO/SAML tied to existing IdP, long-term audit logs retention 7+ years, HSM for key isolation, provenance metadata on all model inputs/outputs. Must satisfy internal security checklist before pilot.

POC asks: air-gapped POC image/installer, architecture review with infra/security, runbook for network setup, sample HSM integration (PKCS#11), SOC run of inference under restricted network. Pricing estimate for 12-mo reserved private capacity and on-prem support SOW.

Commercial: moderate price sensitivity but high priority on SLA and compliance. Procurement expects enterprise contracting and 90-day SLA discussion.

Misc: referenced drive deck + security FAQ shared on 2026-01-15. Two meetings so far (intro + technical deep-dive). AE/SE aligned on next steps.
